# onetsolutions_organizations (Data Source)

Lists the organizations the API key's user belongs to, sorted by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_organizations" "all" {}

output "organization_names" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_organizations.all.organizations[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `organizations` (Attributes List) The organizations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `company_name` (String) The company name on invoices.
- `country` (String) The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the billing address.
- `created` (String) When the organization was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The UUID of the organization.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the organization is active.
- `name` (String) The name of the organization.
- `organization_type` (String) `personal` or `professional`.
- `project_count` (Number) The number of projects in the organization.
- `support_plan` (String) The support plan: `basic`, `advanced` or `business`.
